title: Chakrata
reportingPoint: Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi. Reporting time: 10:30 PM on the departure night.
highlights: Budher Cave trek (5 km hike to the limestone caves)
Tiger Falls, one of Uttarakhand's highest waterfalls
overview:
A weekend escape from Delhi: this **1 Night / 2 Days** Chakrata group trip leaves at night and has you back in Delhi early in the morning two days later. You board the AC bus or traveller at Vaishali Metro Station (reporting 10:30 PM) for the roughly 320 km, 9-hour drive and wake up in Chakrata (about 2,118 m).

Day 1 is the Budher Cave trek, a 5 km hike to the limestone caves, followed by a bonfire evening with snacks, music and dinner at the resort. Day 2 covers Tiger Falls and sunset at Chirmiri Neck Top before the overnight drive back. Travel, a resort stay, the listed meals and a trip coordinator are included. Prices start at ₹4,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi at night
itinerary.content:
Board the bus or traveller from Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi.
Reporting time: 10:30 PM.

itinerary.title: Reach Chakrata | Budher Cave trek
itinerary.content:
Reach Chakrata in the morning. Check in to the resort and rest for a while.
Drive towards Budher Cave for the trek (a hike of about 5 km).
Return to the resort in the evening.
Enjoy a bonfire with snacks and music, then dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tiger Falls and Chirmiri Neck Top
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, check out from the resort and visit Tiger Falls, one of the highest waterfalls in Uttarakhand.
Later, head to Chirmiri Neck Top for a scenic sunset.
Depart for Delhi afterwards and reach by early morning.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: You board the AC bus or traveller at Vaishali Metro Station, Delhi. Reporting time is 10:30 PM on the departure night, and you reach the hills the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Chakrata trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹4,999 per person on quad sharing, ₹5,199 on triple sharing and ₹5,499 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

All travel and transfers in an AC traveller or bus, 1 night in a resort at Chakrata, 1 breakfast, 1 dinner and evening snacks, the Budher Caves trek, visits to Chirmiri Neck Top and Tiger Falls, a bonfire with music, a trip coordinator throughout and 24x7 customer support.
5% GST, meals beyond those listed, entry tickets to monuments and public places, and any expense not mentioned in the inclusions.
Day 1 has the Budher Cave trek, a hike of about 5 km. Wear comfortable trekking or sports shoes.

faqs.q: How far is Chakrata from Delhi?
faqs.a: About 320 km, roughly 9 hours by road. You travel overnight from Delhi and reach Chakrata (about 2,118 m) in the morning.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay 50% of the trip cost to reserve your seat (5% GST is extra on the booking amount), by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and clear the balance 4 days before the trip. Your booking is confirmed once 100% is paid.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
